ELECTRICAL SHOCK EMERGENCY PROCEDURES:

1. DO NOT TOUCH VICTIM IF STILL IN CONTACT WITH POWER

2. De-energize power source if safe to do so (LOTO)

3. If cannot de-energize, use non-conductive material to separate victim

4. Call 911 immediately - advise "electrical shock"

5. Check for breathing/circulation - begin CPR if needed

6. Use AED if available and trained

7. Treat for shock - keep victim warm, elevate legs if no injuries

8. Cover burns with sterile dressing

9. Stay with victim until help arrives

ARC FLASH/BURN EMERGENCY PROCEDURES:

1. Stop - Drop - Roll if clothing on fire

2. Remove victim from source if safe

3. Call 911 immediately - advise "arc flash/burns"

4. Cool burns with cool water (not ice) for 10-15 minutes

5. Cover burns with sterile, non-stick dressing

6. Remove jewelry/constricting items

7. Monitor for shock - keep warm

8. DO NOT apply ointments/butter to burns

FIRE EMERGENCY PROCEDURES:

1. Sound alarm - call 911

2. If safe, use Class C fire extinguisher (CO2 or dry chemical)

3. DO NOT use water on electrical fires

4. De-energize power if safe to do so

5. Evacuate area - account for personnel
